content_sections.heading: ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: Note: Departments 15–25 are Super Specialty posts (Senior Sl. Nos. 15–25 in the source table); the vacancy for these departments depends on the availability of Teaching Faculty in the respective department, and category-wise reservation was not specified for these posts in the notification. Seats may increase or decrease at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: MD/MS/DNB in the concerned Speciality from a recognized University. For TB & Chest , MD/DNB in Pulmonary Medicine, Chest Medicine, or Respiratory Medicine is also eligible. Eligibility as per the Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025. Candidate must hold a valid NMC/State Medical Council registration. Candidates awaiting final PG result may apply but must produce the passing certificate before the interview. Those appearing for the Final Year PG Exam in September 2026 may also apply, but must produce the certificate before the offer of appointment. Note: The date for eligibility of qualifying degree/experience is reckoned as of the date of interview .

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Pay & Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: General Medicine Senior Residents will be posted to Medical ICU, Respiratory ICU, Dialysis Unit and Casualty on rotation, in addition to departmental duties. General Surgery Senior Residents will be posted in Trauma Care Ward and Surgical ICU on rotation. Orthopaedics, General Surgery and General Medicine Senior Residents must perform compulsory on-site Casualty duty as per hospital schedule. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. Accommodation is available on campus; mutual exchange of HRA with accommodation is not allowed until accommodation is available. Attendance must be marked manually as well as on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily.

rows.details: ₹67,700/- per month, plus other admissible allowances
1 year from date of joining, renewable subject to willingness, satisfactory performance and institute requirement
₹20,000/- via Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 2, payable at SBI, Bihta, Patna, at the time of joining (forfeited if the candidate resigns/leaves within 1 year)
No PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority or Promotion admissible; no other benefits extended to contractual employees
Terminable from either side with 1 month's prior notice; absence beyond 7 days is treated as abandonment and leads to termination with forfeiture of security deposit

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: This is a walk-in recruitment; there is no written exam or CBT. Selection is made purely on the basis of credentials and performance in the walk-in interview before the Selection Board. No candidate is allowed to appear for the interview without verification of original documents. Opportunity to interview is provisional, subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria. Results will be displayed on www.mcpatna.esic.gov.in and www.esic.gov.in (Recruitment Section); the Offer of Appointment will be sent by email. The Dean, ESIC MCH, Bihta, reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment process at any stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Appear for the ESIC Bihta Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Important: Application forms will not be accepted after 11:00 AM on the scheduled date. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the walk-in interview or for submitting documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Admit Card / Class 10th certificate for proof of Date of Birth All mark sheets, attempt and degree certificate of MBBS Mark sheets, attempt and degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB/Other, if any EWS/OBC/SC/ST certificate, when applicable NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate (updated) Copies of publications/training/attendance at conferences, workshops, or seminars, if any Aadhaar Card/Voter Card/PAN Card (any 2 of the 3) NOC from current employer, if applicable Relieving certificate from previous employer, if applicable Experience certificate, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Selection to these posts is purely contractual and does not confer any right of confirmation or continuation. If suitable category candidates are unavailable, seats may be filled for less than 45 days by candidates of other categories on merit basis. Unfilled EWS category seats are not carried forward as backlog vacancies; other category candidates may apply provisionally, but will be considered under UR and selected purely on merit. Candidates with incomplete or inadequate documents may not be interviewed; if allowed provisionally, results will be withheld until the required documents are submitted within the stipulated time. All candidates must have an updated Medical Registration certificate reflecting their post-MD/MS/DNB qualification; if not available, proof of "applied for" must be shown at the interview. Candidates employed in Government/Autonomous/Statutory institutions must submit an NOC from their current employer at the walk-in interview, or a copy of "applied for NOC" if immediately unavailable. All selected candidates must have a Relieving Letter from their current employer before joining. Wrong declarations or submission of false information will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage. Warning: Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be interviewed unless the candidate reports on the scheduled date and time with the required documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident posts has ESIC Bihta notified in 2026?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta has notified 41 posts of Senior Resident and Super Specialist Senior Resident across 25 departments, under Advertisement No. 11 of 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is there an online application for ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. This is a walk-in interview; candidates must report in person with a filled application form and documents on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for ESIC Bihta Senior Resident 2026?
faq.answer: 08 September 2026 for Super Specialty departments, 09 September 2026 for Pre and Para Clinical departments, and 10 September 2026 for Clinical departments.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for ESIC Bihta Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A fixed basic pay of ₹67,700/- per month, plus other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for ESIC Bihta Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: MD/MS/DNB in the concerned speciality from a recognized university, with valid NMC/State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Bihta Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹500 for most candidates, via Demand Draft; Nil for SC/ST/ESIC regular employees/Female/Ex-Servicemen/PH candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual appointment for 1 year, renewable subject to performance and requirement, with no PF, pension, gratuity or other regular employee benefits.
